in_marathi.name: Charurani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charurani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charurani is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which translates to 'Divine Chariot'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the deity of knowledge, music, and arts. Charurani is believed to represent the graceful journey of the soul towards enlightenment, symbolizing the divine guidance and protection offered by the goddess.
